summary: Two-story overlook on Massanutten Mountain near Luray; CCC-era tower, rebuilt in 2014, cab no longer in place, reached by hiking trail.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: One hiking guide describes a stone base and an old fire tower; another describes a two-story wood and stone overlook. The 2014 rebuild fits both. A hiking guide's account of an old Depression-era shelter, unsettled between lookout and shelter, is reported in the story but not adopted.

notes_for_editor: Build year not found. The CCC is named by a 2014 blog and the 1991 state survey gives only a statewide CCC total (88 lookout towers through 1941), not a date for this site. The rebuild date, PATC role and Fort Valley Ranch help come from that one blog; the PATC newsletter it cites was not read. FFLA Standing* footnote confirms the cab is gone. Record county is Page / Shenandoah; a hiker notes crossing the Page-Shenandoah border near the trailhead, so the record may be right. No closure notice, staffing or fire history found. Hiking guides disagree on the structure, as the story says.
